name: Rain of Fire (Magic Skull Games)
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

Components: V, S, M/DF (a pinch of ashes and a piece of igneous rock)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Area: Cylinder (20-ft. radius, 40 ft. high)

Duration: 1 full round

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell is identical to ice storm but creates a rain of crackling, flaming sparks. There is no bludgeoning damage, but the flaming sparks cause 5d6 points of fire damage. Perception and land movement penalties still apply.
